question:
**Direction: In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

Fairly and squarely
solution:
The correct answer is **"Honestly."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Fairly and squarely"** means honestly and justly. (ईमानदारी से और न्यायपूर्वक)

 
 
• **Example**: *She lays the blame for the recession **fairly and squarely**__ on the government.*
 
 
 
• **"Honestly" **means in an honest way. (ईमानदारी से, सत्‍यनिष्‍ठ भाव से)
 __
 
• **Example**: *He tried to answer the lawyer’s questions **honestly**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Suddenly" **means happening quickly and unexpectedly. (एकाएक, अचानक)
 
• **Option 2: "Rigorously"** means with great care and attention to detail. (परिशुद्घता के साथ)

 
 
• **Option 3: "Wholly"** means completely or entirely. (पूरी तरह, पूर्णतया; सर्वथा)
